Third-party license notices: d3-array, d3-format, d3-scale, d3-time, d3-time-format, d3-interpolate, d3-color, d3-scale-chromatic, d3-shape and d3-path
====================================================================================================================================================

DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.VegaLite contains ports of numeric algorithms of the
d3-array, d3-format and d3-scale packages (tick generation, tick step
selection, domain extension to round values ("nice"), number formatting, tick
label formats and the linear, band, point and ordinal scales), ports of the
calendar interval algorithms of d3-time (floor, ceil, offset, count, every and
range of the time intervals, and the time ticks and "nice" of the d3-scale time
scale) and of the date formatting and parsing of d3-time-format (the
directives, the padding flags and the English locale), ports of the
color interpolation and conversion algorithms of d3-interpolate and d3-color
(sRGB, HSL, CIELAB and HCL), the quantize, quantile, threshold, sequential and
diverging scales of d3-scale, and the category color values of
d3-scale-chromatic (category10, observable10, rainbow, sinebow and the
ColorBrewer qualitative sets), and ports of the curve interpolators and the
line, area and arc generators of d3-shape (linear, step, basis, cardinal,
Catmull-Rom, monotone and natural curves) and of the path writer of d3-path
(move, line, arc and close commands), which are released under the ISC License.
The license text of each package is reproduced below exactly as published in the
package repositories (https://github.com/d3/d3-array,
https://github.com/d3/d3-format, https://github.com/d3/d3-scale,
https://github.com/d3/d3-time, https://github.com/d3/d3-time-format,
https://github.com/d3/d3-scale-chromatic, https://github.com/d3/d3-interpolate,
https://github.com/d3/d3-color, https://github.com/d3/d3-shape and
https://github.com/d3/d3-path).

This project is not affiliated with, and is not endorsed or promoted by, the
D3 project or its authors.
